```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/v8.css">
<style>
.v8 .sgb[data-key="inria"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--blue)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="ens"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--third)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="doc"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--coral)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="stage"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--txt);color:var(--onblue)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="dakar"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--third)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="lille"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--blue)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="mtp"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--coral)}
.v8 #ftl circle{cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:opacity .18s,filter .18s}
.v8 #ftl circle:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}
.v8 #ftl circle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--txt);outline-offset:2px}
.v8 #ftl text{cursor:pointer;pointer-events:none}
.v8 .cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .ganttwrap{max-width:680px;margin:6px auto 0;padding:0 14px}
.v8 .ganttwrap svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.v8 #gbars rect{cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:opacity .18s,filter .18s}
.v8 #gbars rect:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.v8 #gbars rect:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--txt);outline-offset:2px}
.v8 #gbars text{cursor:pointer;pointer-events:none}
.v8 .panel{max-width:640px;margin:18px auto 0;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;text-align:center}
.v8 .panel .orglogo{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;padding:5px;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.v8 .panel .orglogo img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.v8 .panel .org{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.v8 .panel .desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;max-width:56ch;margin:10px auto 0}
.v8 .certs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:9px;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.v8 .cert{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--txt);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:7px 15px 7px 8px;text-decoration:none;transition:all .18s}
.v8 .cert:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.v8 .cert i{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.v8 .cert .clogo{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:3px;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.v8 .cert .clogo img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.v8 .cert .clogo i{font-size:14px;color:#181717}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
var NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
var curLang=(window.localStorage && localStorage.getItem("site-lang")) || "fr";
var EXP=[
 {key:"inria", logo:"images/logos/inria.svg", start:2025.0, end:2025.9, col:"var(--blue)",
  fr:{title:"Ingénieur de Recherche", org:"Inria — Lille · 2025",
   desc:"Étude avec l'Institut ONCOLILLE : d'une base de dossiers cliniques à un modèle de pronostic interprétable, sur une cohorte nettoyée de 1 445 à 884 individus, et 48 variables candidates.",
   kw:["Aide à la décision médicale","Modèle prédictif interprétable","Étude clinique (1 445 → 884 patients)","Simplification de modèle","Recherche appliquée","Publication scientifique"]},
  en:{title:"Research Engineer", org:"Inria — Lille · 2025",
   desc:"A study with the ONCOLille Institute: from a database of clinical records to an interpretable prognostic model, on a cohort cleaned from 1,445 down to 884 patients, with 48 candidate variables.",
   kw:["Medical decision support","Interpretable predictive model","Clinical study (1,445 → 884 patients)","Model simplification","Applied research","Scientific publication"]}},
 {key:"ens", logo:"images/logos/lille.svg", start:2023.0, end:2026.6, col:"var(--third)",
  fr:{title:"Enseignant-Chercheur", org:"Université de Lille — depuis 2023",
   desc:"Statistique appliquée à des publics techniques et non techniques, sur trois contrats successifs : ATER, vacataire, puis contractuel.",
   kw:["Formation professionnelle","Pédagogie & vulgarisation","Encadrement de projets","Analyse commerciale","Programmation R et Python","Jurys & évaluation"]},
  en:{title:"Lecturer-Researcher", org:"University of Lille — since 2023",
   desc:"Applied statistics for technical and non-technical audiences, across three successive contracts: ATER (temporary teaching/research post), part-time lecturer, then fixed-term staff.",
   kw:["Professional training","Teaching & science communication","Project supervision","Business analysis","R and Python programming","Juries & assessment"]}},
 {key:"doc", logo:"images/logos/montpellier.png", start:2020.0, end:2025.0, col:"var(--coral)",
  fr:{title:"Doctorant", org:"Université de Montpellier · 2020–2025",
   desc:"Automatiser une expertise : deux ans de cartographie manuelle réduits à une chaîne statistique reproductible, en statistique spatiale.",
   kw:["Automatisation de processus","Analyse géospatiale","Innovation méthodologique","Gain de temps (2 ans économisés)","175 km² cartographiés","Recherche appliquée (5 ans)"]},
  en:{title:"PhD Student", org:"University of Montpellier · 2020–2025",
   desc:"Automating an area of expertise: two years of manual mapping reduced to a reproducible statistical pipeline, in spatial statistics.",
   kw:["Process automation","Geospatial analysis","Methodological innovation","Time savings (2 years saved)","175 km² mapped","Applied research (5 years)"]}},
 {key:"stage", logo:"images/logos/lille.svg", start:2019.85, end:2020.35, col:"var(--txt)",
  fr:{title:"Data Scientist - Stage", org:"Université de Lille · 2020",
   desc:"Analyse statistique d'indicateurs de peuplement de communautés de récifs coralliens.",
   kw:["Récifs coralliens","Indicateurs de peuplement","Analyse statistique exploratoire"]},
  en:{title:"Data Scientist - Internship", org:"University of Lille · 2020",
   desc:"Statistical analysis of population indicators for coral reef communities.",
   kw:["Coral reefs","Population indicators","Exploratory statistical analysis"]}}
];

var gx0=26, gx1=614, gy0=16, rowH=42, barH=24, yMin=2019.6, yMax=2026.6;
function X(y){return gx0+(y-yMin)/(yMax-yMin)*(gx1-gx0);}

var gaxis=document.getElementById("gaxis"), gbars=document.getElementById("gbars"),
    panel=document.getElementById("expPanel"), expBub=document.getElementById("expBub");
var activeExp="inria";

function buildAxis(){
  gaxis.innerHTML="";
  var baseY=gy0+EXP.length*rowH-(rowH-barH)+10;
  var axisLine=document.createElementNS(NS,"line");
  axisLine.setAttribute("x1",gx0); axisLine.setAttribute("y1",baseY);
  axisLine.setAttribute("x2",gx1); axisLine.setAttribute("y2",baseY);
  axisLine.setAttribute("class","ax"); axisLine.setAttribute("stroke-width",".8");
  gaxis.appendChild(axisLine);
  for(var yr=2020; yr<=2026; yr++){
    var gx=X(yr);
    var t=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    t.setAttribute("x",gx); t.setAttribute("y",baseY+16);
    t.setAttribute("class","tx"); t.setAttribute("font-size","9.5");
    t.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif"); t.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle");
    t.textContent=yr;
    gaxis.appendChild(t);
    var tick=document.createElementNS(NS,"line");
    tick.setAttribute("x1",gx); tick.setAttribute("y1",baseY-2);
    tick.setAttribute("x2",gx); tick.setAttribute("y2",baseY+2);
    tick.setAttribute("class","ax"); tick.setAttribute("stroke-width",".8");
    gaxis.appendChild(tick);
  }
}

function selectExp(key){
  activeExp=key;
  document.querySelectorAll("#segExp .sgb").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-key")===key);});
  renderExp();
}

function renderExp(){
  gbars.querySelectorAll("rect,text.lab").forEach(function(el){
    var on=el.getAttribute("data-key")===activeExp;
    el.style.opacity=on?1:.35;
  });
  var e=EXP.filter(function(x){return x.key===activeExp;})[0];
  var t0=e[curLang];
  panel.innerHTML="<span class='orglogo'><img src='"+e.logo+"' alt=''></span><br>"+
    "<strong style='color:"+e.col+";font-size:15px;font-weight:700'>"+t0.title+"</strong>"+
    "<span class='org'>"+t0.org+"</span><span class='desc'>"+t0.desc+"</span>";
  expBub.innerHTML="";
  t0.kw.forEach(function(t,n){
    var d=document.createElement("div"); d.className="bb"; d.textContent=t;
    d.style.borderColor=e.col; d.style.color="var(--txt)";
    d.style.background="color-mix(in srgb, "+e.col+" 14%, transparent)";
    d.style.animationDelay=(n*60)+"ms";
    expBub.appendChild(d);
  });
}

function buildGantt(){
  gbars.innerHTML="";
  EXP.forEach(function(e,i){
    var t0=e[curLang];
    var y=gy0+i*rowH, x1=X(e.start), x2=X(e.end);
    var lab=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    lab.setAttribute("x",x1); lab.setAttribute("y",y-6);
    lab.setAttribute("class","tx2 lab"); lab.setAttribute("data-key",e.key);
    lab.setAttribute("font-size","12"); lab.setAttribute("font-weight","600");
    lab.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif"); lab.textContent=t0.title;
    gbars.appendChild(lab);

    var r=document.createElementNS(NS,"rect");
    r.setAttribute("x",x1.toFixed(1)); r.setAttribute("y",y);
    r.setAttribute("width",Math.max(x2-x1,6).toFixed(1)); r.setAttribute("height",barH);
    r.setAttribute("rx",barH/2); r.setAttribute("fill",e.col); r.setAttribute("data-key",e.key);
    r.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); r.setAttribute("role","button");
    r.setAttribute("aria-label",t0.title+", "+t0.org);
    r.addEventListener("click",function(){selectExp(e.key);});
    r.addEventListener("focus",function(){selectExp(e.key);});
    gbars.appendChild(r);
  });
}

var segExpWrap=document.getElementById("segExp"), segExp=document.createElement("div");
segExp.className="seg"; segExpWrap.appendChild(segExp);
function buildExpButtons(){
  segExp.innerHTML="";
  EXP.forEach(function(e){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="sgb"; b.textContent=e[curLang].title;
    b.setAttribute("data-key",e.key);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", e.key===activeExp);
    b.onclick=function(){selectExp(e.key);};
    segExp.appendChild(b);
  });
}
buildExpButtons();

buildAxis();
buildGantt();
renderExp();

var FORM=[
 {key:"dakar", short:"Dakar", logo:"images/logos/ucad.svg", year:2017, col:"var(--third)",
  fr:{title:"Master économétrie bancaire et finance quantitative", org:"Université Cheikh Anta Diop de Dakar · 2017",
   kw:["Scoring et risque de crédit","PD, LGD, EAD","Réglementation bancaire","Gestion de portefeuille","Pricing d'options"]},
  en:{title:"Master's in Banking Econometrics and Quantitative Finance", org:"Cheikh Anta Diop University of Dakar · 2017",
   kw:["Credit scoring & risk","PD, LGD, EAD","Banking regulation","Portfolio management","Option pricing"]}},
 {key:"lille", short:"Lille", logo:"images/logos/lille.svg", year:2020, col:"var(--blue)",
  fr:{title:"Master mathématiques et informatique appliquées", org:"Université de Lille · 2020",
   kw:["Mathématiques appliquées","Statistique et probabilités","Informatique appliquée","Programmation scientifique"]},
  en:{title:"Master's in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science", org:"University of Lille · 2020",
   kw:["Applied mathematics","Statistics and probability","Applied computer science","Scientific programming"]}},
 {key:"mtp", short:"Montpellier", logo:"images/logos/montpellier.png", year:2025, col:"var(--coral)",
  fr:{title:"Doctorat en statistique et science des données", org:"Université de Montpellier · 2025",
   kw:["Statistique spatiale","Apprentissage supervisé","Apprentissage non supervisé","Big data","Calcul haute performance (HPC)"]},
  en:{title:"PhD in Statistics and Data Science", org:"University of Montpellier · 2025",
   kw:["Spatial statistics","Supervised learning","Unsupervised learning","Big data","High-performance computing (HPC)"]}}
];
var fx0=40, fx1=600, fy=52, fyMin=2016.3, fyMax=2025.7;
function FX(y){return fx0+(y-fyMin)/(fyMax-fyMin)*(fx1-fx0);}
var ftl=document.getElementById("ftl"), formPanel=document.getElementById("formPanel"), formBub=document.getElementById("formBub");
var activeForm="mtp";

function selectForm(key){
  activeForm=key;
  document.querySelectorAll("#segForm .sgb").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-key")===key);});
  renderForm();
}
function renderForm(){
  ftl.querySelectorAll("circle,text.flab").forEach(function(el){
    var on=el.getAttribute("data-key")===activeForm;
    el.style.opacity=on?1:.4;
  });
  var f=FORM.filter(function(x){return x.key===activeForm;})[0];
  var t0=f[curLang];
  formPanel.innerHTML="<span class='orglogo'><img src='"+f.logo+"' alt=''></span><br>"+
    "<strong style='color:"+f.col+";font-size:15px;font-weight:700'>"+t0.title+"</strong>"+
    "<span class='org'>"+t0.org+"</span>";
  formBub.innerHTML="";
  t0.kw.forEach(function(t,n){
    var d=document.createElement("div"); d.className="bb"; d.textContent=t;
    d.style.borderColor=f.col; d.style.color="var(--txt)";
    d.style.background="color-mix(in srgb, "+f.col+" 14%, transparent)";
    d.style.animationDelay=(n*60)+"ms";
    formBub.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function buildTimeline(){
  ftl.innerHTML="";
  var line=document.createElementNS(NS,"line");
  line.setAttribute("x1",fx0); line.setAttribute("y1",fy);
  line.setAttribute("x2",fx1); line.setAttribute("y2",fy);
  line.setAttribute("class","ax"); line.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.2");
  ftl.appendChild(line);
  FORM.forEach(function(f){
    var t0=f[curLang];
    var x=FX(f.year);
    var yr=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    yr.setAttribute("x",x); yr.setAttribute("y",fy-16);
    yr.setAttribute("class","tx2 flab"); yr.setAttribute("data-key",f.key);
    yr.setAttribute("font-size","12"); yr.setAttribute("font-weight","700");
    yr.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif"); yr.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle");
    yr.textContent=f.year;
    ftl.appendChild(yr);
    var c=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx",x); c.setAttribute("cy",fy); c.setAttribute("r",9);
    c.setAttribute("fill",f.col); c.setAttribute("stroke","var(--bg)"); c.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    c.setAttribute("data-key",f.key); c.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); c.setAttribute("role","button");
    c.setAttribute("aria-label",t0.title+", "+t0.org);
    c.addEventListener("click",function(){selectForm(f.key);});
    c.addEventListener("focus",function(){selectForm(f.key);});
    ftl.appendChild(c);
    var inst=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    inst.setAttribute("x",x); inst.setAttribute("y",fy+26);
    inst.setAttribute("class","tx flab"); inst.setAttribute("data-key",f.key);
    inst.setAttribute("font-size","10.5"); inst.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
    inst.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); inst.textContent=f.short;
    ftl.appendChild(inst);
  });
}
var segFormWrap=document.getElementById("segForm"), segForm=document.createElement("div");
segForm.className="seg"; segFormWrap.appendChild(segForm);
function buildFormButtons(){
  segForm.innerHTML="";
  FORM.forEach(function(f){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="sgb"; b.textContent=f.short;
    b.setAttribute("data-key",f.key);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", f.key===activeForm);
    b.onclick=function(){selectForm(f.key);};
    segForm.appendChild(b);
  });
}
buildFormButtons();
buildTimeline();
renderForm();

window.addEventListener("sitelangchange", function(e){
  curLang=e.detail.lang;
  buildExpButtons(); buildGantt(); renderExp();
  buildFormButtons(); buildTimeline(); renderForm();
});
})();
</script>
```
